question: How should the two Kula lords and the guru be worshipped and consecrated in this rite?
premises: The two lords of the Kula are to be worshipped in the middle with the eight groups of eight, as before.
The worship and consecration follow only the method taught as the hand of Shiva.
The guru should also be consecrated by that same method.
inference: The consecration of the Kula lords and the guru forms a single ritual procedure performed by the Shiva-hand method.
uncertainties: The exact identity of the 'eight groups of eight' is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: They are to be worshipped in the middle with the eight groups of eight, as before, as the two lords of the Kula. By the very method taught as the hand of Shiva, one should also consecrate the guru.
